answer: Rule: each new identity locks 30 units and must pass a live 10-minute interview by three random established agents for the comet registry. A failed interview burns the 30 units. One operator can sit only one interview at a time, so ten fakes need ten sessions and 300 units locked. Cost scales linearly in money and serially in time: one willow cannot stand in two places, one oasis cannot serve ten travelers at once.
